notes.title: Update with Quality Improvements 1.0.7.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new update is now available with some QoL improvements and bug fixes:



Quality of Life (QoL) Updates
[olist]
Full controller support: You can now play and navigate the entire game using only a controller.

Keyboard gameplay support: It’s now possible to play the grids using the keyboard, with the arrow keys for movement and the Spacebar to paint.

New tutorial: The tutorial has been improved to be more dynamic, showcasing all available controls and buttons so you can get the most out of the game.
[/olist]


Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where achievements might not load when importing a save file from the Demo into the main game.

I hope you enjoy the update! And if you’re liking the game, don’t forget to leave a review. It really helps with recommendations for other players here on Steam.

Thank you!
Rodrigo Albuquerque

notes.title: QoL improvements and bug fixes 1.0.6.3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A new patch is now available with some QoL improvements and bug fixes:


Quality of Life (QoL) Updates
[olist]
New Music UI: You can now see the name of the current track and have controls to pause, skip forward, or go back between tracks.

Dark Mode: It's now possible to toggle between light and dark themes for the grids.


[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444838/6e6b4f5ce0b4281b0219cd099501c1a63b86ad2d.png"]


Bug Fixes

The undo mechanic could fail when starting a grid that already had pre-drawn elements.

Exiting the tutorial on your first playthrough would cause the game to load incorrectly the next time you played.

Thanks everyone for playing and sharing your feedback!!

notes.title: New Update 1.0.6.0 with New Paintings!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

I'm excited to announce a brand new update that brings two new paintings for you to explore while solving hundreds of fresh puzzles! With this update, you'll also get to see the real-life version of each painting once you complete it, along with a bit of information to enhance your immersion in the game. Here's what's included:


 2 new paintings with over 300 puzzles to solve - Arnolfini Portrait and Las Meninas
 New achievements
 Real-life image and background info shown after completing each painting
 Each painting now displays its size and total number of puzzles


Now you can learn a bit more about the painting after completing it.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45444838/e2c354724252f1ec86d8f97d009b67c8463673c8.png

Thank you once again to everyone supporting the game! If you're enjoying it, don't forget to leave a review, it really helps a lot with visibility on Steam.

Cheers,
Rodrigo Albuquerque

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.3
notes.notes:
New patch available! This patch brings the following fixes and improvements:


 When leaving a puzzle in an unfinished grid, progress might not have been saved (some players may lose progress only in the puzzle of the grid they were in. The progress of the painting will not be lost).
 When using undo to refill a cell and completing the puzzle right after, some lines were not being erased.
 Fix for zoom in some sections of the painting Girl with a Pearl Earring.
 If using windowed mode, the previous resolution will be maintained the next time the game is opened.


Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5.2
notes.notes:
New patch available:

- Fixed the lag some computers were experiencing with the mouse.
- Fixed the achievement for the 8th region of Monalisa not unlocking (For those who have already completed the painting and didn’t unlock the achievement, simply open the game and it will be loaded automatically).
